messages:
Alex (partnerships): Quick Q — can we lock the SI intake ownership window + demo kit rules before tomorrow's sync? Need this for the marketplace listing checklist.
Jen (SI-lead): Yes, we need a clear claiming window. Proposal: 5 business days from initial intake attribution, then auto-escalate to partnerships. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Sophia (AE): 5 days sounds ok for inbound leads. For warm co-sell leads coming from SIs, can we shorten to 48h? They move fast.
Marco (marketplace): Shorter window for marketplace-sourced leads makes sense. We should also mark leads with `Marketplace_Referral` tag so automation can route.
Sam (revops): Agree on tags. Suggested SFDC mapping: set `Partner_Source__c = "SI"` and `Partner_Claim_Expiry__c = <claim_ts + 5d>` for auto-unclaim. We can implement workflow rules.
Alex (partnerships): Good — can someone paste the exact SFDC trigger syntax we should document? I want to include it in the intake SOP.
Sam (revops): Quick snippet for the SOP: `IF Partner_Source__c == 'SI' AND Claimed__c == TRUE THEN set Claim_Expiry__c = NOW() + 5` (48h override for `Channel = Marketplace`). I'll put full rule in Confluence.
Jen (SI-lead): Also: demo kit ownership — if SI provides the initial demo, they keep credit but Redwood owns the NDA and joint collateral. SIs get 1-touch private demo assets (recording + slide deck). Redwood provides canonical deck + demo env.
Sophia (AE): Important: if AE engages within the claim window and converts, revenue splits follow the existing ROE, but we need visibility in the pipeline stage. Please ensure a `SI_Motion` checkbox on opps.
Marco (marketplace): Marketplace Bot just flagged a dependency: marketplace listings with 'co-sell' badge must include a verified demo kit link and partner contact. We should add a required field on the listing form.
Marketplace Bot: Reminder — listing form validation failure: "Missing demo_kit_url" for partner_id 9843.
Lina (legal): Quick legal note: before sharing partner-specific demo recordings or customer PII, confirm NDA + DPA scope. We can pre-approve a standard consent checkbox that SIs sign during onboarding.
Jen (SI-lead): Understood, will add an onboarding checkbox. Also propose a conflict-resolution path: if two SIs claim same account, priority to first claim; if same timestamp, Partnerships triages within 24h.
Alex (partnerships): Can we add escalation tags to SFDC? `Claim_Dispute__c = TRUE` and assign queue `partnerships-disputes`
Sam (revops): Yep — I'll add a queue + a lightweight automation that notifies partnerships Slack when a dispute is created.
Sophia (AE): One more: joint announcement timing. If SI wants a joint press/social announcement, require 10 business days notice and PR review by Redwood comms. Add to intake checklist.
Marco (marketplace): Also recommend a small playbook paragraph for hardware partners where lead cycles are longer — extend claim window to 10 business days for hardware-integrated opportunities.
Alex (partnerships): Noted — so summary decisions: default claim window = 5 business days, marketplace inbound = 48h, hardware = 10 business days. SI demo kit required for co-sell badge. NDA checkbox required at onboarding. Dispute workflow -> partnerships triage within 24h. PR notice = 10 business days.
Jen (SI-lead): I'll draft the intake template and demo kit checklist (slides, recording, test account, contact). Will post here when ready. :thumbsup:
Lina (legal): When you post the template tag me — I'll add the NDA verbiage and a short data handling clause.
Sam (revops): Ticketing action: I'll create rollout epic for the SFDC fields/workflows and a GH issue for the marketplace form validation. ETA next Tuesday.
Alex (partnerships): Thanks team. If nobody objects, I'll publish the updated SOP to Confluence after Jen's draft and Sam's SFDC PR.
Sophia (AE): No objections. This will help reduce messy handoffs.
Marco (marketplace): +1. Also can we add a weekly 15m slot to triage newly unclaimed opps? Helps catch misses.
Alex (partnerships): Good idea — adding a standing 15m every Wed at 10:15 PT. Invite going out.
Jen (SI-lead): Will join. Posting draft in ~2 hours.
Marketplace Bot: New calendar event created: Partnerships SI Claim Triage — Wed 10:15 PT (recurring).
Alex (partnerships): Closing for now — tagging action owners: Jen (template), Sam (SFDC/workflows), Marco (listing form), Lina (legal), Sophia (ops + AE checks).
